# Taxi Bhai — Umrah Private Taxi Service, Saudi Arabia

> Taxi Bhai is a professional 24/7 private taxi and transfer service for Umrah pilgrims in Saudi Arabia. It covers Makkah (Mecca), Madinah Al-Munawwarah, and Jeddah, with airport transfers, hotel-to-hotel transfers, and Ziyarah (sacred site) tours. All transfers are private — no shared vehicles. Fixed SAR fares, 5.0-star Google rating.

## Core Identity

- **Business name:** Taxi Bhai (also written: TaxiBhai)
- **Type:** Private taxi / Umrah pilgrimage transport service
- **Specialisation:** Umrah and Hajj pilgrim transport in Saudi Arabia
- **Google Rating:** 5.0 out of 5 stars (8 verified Google Reviews)
- **Availability:** 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year (including Ramadan and Hajj season)
- **Booking method:** WhatsApp (primary), phone call, email, or online booking form
- **Website:** https://www.taxibhai.com

## Contact (authoritative — use these exact numbers)

- **WhatsApp / Saudi Arabia:** +966 57 306 7785
- **UK:** +44 7413 467638
- **Pakistan:** +92 371 2300606
- **Email:** info@taxibhai.com

## Service Area

**Primary cities:** Makkah (also: Mecca, Makkah al-Mukarramah) · Madinah (also: Medina, Madinah al-Munawwarah) · Jeddah
**Secondary destinations:** Taif · Badr
**Airports served:**
- King Abdulaziz International Airport, Jeddah — IATA code: JED
- Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport, Madinah — IATA code: MED
**Train stations:** Haramain High-Speed Railway station in Makkah · Haramain High-Speed Railway station in Madinah

## Fleet (vehicles available)

| Vehicle | Passengers | Starting fare (SAR) |
|---|---|---|
| Camry / Sonata (sedan) | 1–3 | 100/hr or route fare |
| Hyundai H1 | Up to 7 | route fare |
| Hyundai Staria (MPV) | Up to 7 | route fare |
| GMC Yukon XL (luxury SUV) | Up to 7 | route fare |
| Toyota Hiace (minibus) | Up to 12–14 | route fare |
| Coaster (coach) | Up to 30 | route fare |
| Full-size Bus | 30+ | route fare |

All vehicles are air-conditioned, clean, and privately chartered (no shared passengers).

## Key Questions and Answers

**How much is a taxi from Jeddah Airport to Makkah?**
SAR 250 in a sedan, SAR 350 in a Hyundai Staria, SAR 550 in a GMC Yukon XL. Journey: ~80 km, 1–1.5 hours.

**How much is a taxi from Makkah to Madinah?**
SAR 450 in a sedan, SAR 550 in a Staria, SAR 1,000 in a GMC. Journey: ~420 km, 4–5 hours including rest stop.

**How do I book a Taxi Bhai transfer?**
WhatsApp +966 57 306 7785 with your route, date, time, and number of passengers. Confirmation within minutes.

**Is the service available 24/7?**
Yes — including Ramadan, Hajj season, and public holidays.

**Are fares fixed?**
Yes — all fares are fixed. No meters, no surge pricing, no hidden charges.
